The party leader icon shows on the leader only instead of on several party members.
Set Focus and Clear Focus in the raid and party frame menu work out of combat without the 'blocked from an action' popup; in combat they are hidden, use a Click Casting Focus binding there.
Ready check icons show on raid and party frames again.
Hide Sated / Exhaustion also hides the 81005 Bloodlust lockout debuff.
Pet frames no longer throw a SecureTemplates strupper error when they first appear.
The Buffs/Debuffs editor's Add New menu no longer closes on the first click.
Element Options for raid and party frames now open the matching settings.

Profile strings exported from Retail EllesmereUI import everything this client supports: each module keeps its current settings and takes the Retail values it understands. Retail-only modules, spec setups and Cooldown Manager spells are skipped, and chat reports how many settings came in.

A button on Global Settings puts back the game settings EUI changed (nameplate, minimap, chat and tooltip options, chat font sizes and keys Quickdraw took), then turns EUI off for this character and reloads. Your profiles are kept.
A drawn cooldown sweep for modules that want round or colored swipes; the Wrath client's own swipe is always a dark square. Cooldown Manager uses it first.

When a guild or group member runs a newer EllesmereUI release, chat tells you once per session. Type /euiupdate for the download link. Wrath has no internet access, so the news comes from other EUI users.
The Locales addon provides community translations for all original Wrath client languages, with English fallback and Lua 5.1 formatting.
The collapsed menu displays the original Ellesmere E logo with the UI accent color and a working close icon on the Wrath client.
Fonts, bar textures and sounds that other addons register with LibSharedMedia appear in the EllesmereUI menus, including ones registered after login.
A shared outline picker for individual texts: None, Outline, Thick Outline or Shadow, with Module Default following the Fonts page. Text keeps its color when you switch.
The Incompatible Addon popup can disable the other addon or the affected EllesmereUI module and reload. Okay and Don't show again work as before.
Per-spec setting groups with automatic capture and their own Unlock Mode layouts, plus conditional overrides for dungeons, raids, arenas, battlegrounds, solo play and out of combat.
The Esc menu has EllesmereUI and EUI Unlock Mode buttons, shown by default. Both follow the EUI Buttons setting in Global Settings.
With Show Spell ID on Tooltip on, item tooltips add the item ID and icon file name. Each line has its own toggle

Raid and Unit Frames read absorb shields from a shared estimate: rank base value plus your own spell power, minus what each shield absorbs in the combat log. Clients with a native absorb API use it directly
Arena Frames joins the sidebar, first-use list, profiles, spec overrides, module fonts and search
Profile strings and shared exports work again
An ice blue options theme; Match Accent to Theme follows each theme's palette
Lights, beams, music and spin on boss kills, arena and battleground wins, Bloodlust/Heroism and level ups
Show Spell ID on Tooltip covers spells, action buttons, auras and chat links (off by default)
The options sidebar shows the combined memory used by all loaded EllesmereUI addons
The sidebar sync button opens its profile list again instead of erroring when you have more than one profile.

Retail profile strings bring their element positions: action, XP and menu bars, CDM bars, raid and party frames, chat, damage meter windows, QoL displays, resource bars and the fixed tooltip land where the creator placed them.
Nameplates-only Retail profile strings are recognised as Retail; bar width and height, cast bar height and color, name size and aura sizes carry over.
Unlock Mode: the top bar toggle icons and labels are brighter, so they no longer read dark grey on the banner.
Set Focus and Clear Focus in right-click menus from EUI frames go through a secure button out of combat instead of being blocked; in combat they are hidden.
Unlock Mode: the arrow keys move the selected element 1 pixel again (hold Shift for 100).
Works alongside !!!ClassicAPI: its clipping and mask functions are no longer used on EUI frames, so animated glows and the options panel stop erroring.
Opening the options no longer errors with \"attempt to index local 'mask'\" on clients where another addon adds an empty mask function.
The profile Import and Export boxes no longer error with \"attempt to call method 'GetNumLines'\" and scroll to fit long strings.
The collapsed menu shows the Ellesmere E logo again instead of a plain black circle.
Action button tooltips show the real spell ID instead of the spellbook slot.
Fixed an \"attempt to call global 'issecretvalue'\" error from Cooldown Manager glows before the options panel was first opened.
Unlock Mode widget tooltips use Wrath-compatible alpha fades, fixing the SetFromAlpha error on Grow Right.
The options search results list has a fully opaque background with its results drawn above it, so sidebar and page text no longer bleeds into the results.
Unlock Mode no longer errors on SetMaxLines when it first opens, so element movers appear again.
The Patch Notes reminder dot now lights after each backport update.
The options search results now draw above the sidebar and page instead of behind them.
The Unlock Mode right-click menu no longer closes right after opening when many elements are on screen.
Opening the Raid Frames options no longer causes a stack overflow in Settings Overrides.
Unlock Mode art, options page icons and the Unlock Mode top bar are now visible and readable.
The addon list shows clean module names, grouped under EllesmereUI in addon managers.
Search Features and Search Module Settings accept typing again.
Clients whose atlas lookup errors on unknown names (such as custom 3.3.5 clients with Retail UI ports) no longer stop EllesmereUI files from loading.

Like Retail 9.4, the DataBars page opens with a bar selector at the top: rename or delete a bar right in its menu, or pick + Create New DataBar. + New Bar shows the four starter templates as cards, and with no bars yet the page shows them as a card grid.

Like Retail 9.4, the options window has a Window Scale slider in its top corner that resizes it in smooth 5% steps; the mouse wheel over it, or Shift + mouse wheel anywhere on the window, works too. The credit to Ellesmere now sits under the close button.

Global Settings opens with Reset ALL EUI Addon Settings and Uninstall EUI side by side, like Retail 9.4. Reset ALL now asks you to type Confirm. Optimize My FPS and Graphics is gone: the graphics settings it changed do not exist on this client.

Like Retail 9.4, each look card on the Style page has a menu of the modules using it: tick modules under another look, then press Apply Styles to switch them all with one reload. The menus list only looks this client can draw: Cooldown Manager, Minimap and Damage Meters offer EllesmereUI and Classic WoW UI, Player Aura Bars is gone, and Apply to All skips modules without that look.

The import page can update your current profile instead of making a new one: tick Import into current profile and the string's selected modules (for example only Nameplates) replace their settings there while the rest of the profile stays.
The EUI Staff page opens with thanks to Ellesmere and the port staff card with a GitHub link to the releases. The header line crediting Ellesmere opens it.
Custom spell reminders, visibility and sounds are saved separately for each character, independently of shared profiles.
Optional achievement, trade and guild recruitment filters, plus your own blocked words and phrases.
Configure repeat timing, sender matching and chat scopes from the new Spam Filter page.
Outline menus in the Nameplates and Unit Frames text cogs, and Zone Text Outline in Quality of Life. The Unit Frames preview shows each text's outline.
New PETS and DIMINISHING RETURNS sections, plus Fade Out of Range and its opacity under Target and Visibility.
Announce Interrupts and Accept Invites from Friends & Guild in the GROUP section, and a Disband Group button on Raid Tools.
Bar Display, Menu, Bags & XP Bars and Bar Animations, with a live preview of the selected bar. Click an icon, keybind or count to jump to its setting.
The Raid and Party pages gain the Retail DISPELS section and a Preview Mode (Real, Overlay or No Preview) at the top.
Party and Raid pages gain a TARGETED SPELLS section: mode, preview, icon size, maximum icons, position, growth, offsets, cast swipe, cast timer and interruptible colors.
Raid Frames (Party and Raid) and Unit Frames (player, target, focus) gain an ABSORBS section for the estimated shields, with a shield in the Unit Frames preview.

CDM Bars now opens with Retail's bar dropdown (rename or delete custom bars, add Cooldowns, Utility, Buff or FocusKick bars) and the selected bar's icons: drag to reorder, click an icon to edit it, middle-click to remove it, and use + to add spells or buffs.
Hide server announcements such as \"Name the level 11 Gnome Warrior has been slain by ... in Westfall\", optionally keeping deaths from a chosen level up visible.
The FocusKick Cast Sound and the Chat sounds list EllesmereUI and SharedMedia sounds, and the Textures page links Damage Meters to its per-window Bar Texture
New dropdown at the top of Icons, with a link to apply it to every bar. The preview shows the shape.
Boss Debuff Icon, Icon Size, Icon Offset Y and Show Dispellable When No Boss Debuff under Dispels
General, Layout, Health and Power, Text, Icons, Cast Bar and Target and Visibility sections
Display, Extras and Wrath Inventory settings, including Delete Saved Character
Class icon themes, class colored names, borders, accent colors, faction banners and invite auto-accept
Display, Colors, General and Aura Filters with inline color swatches and cog menus
Quick Loot, Auto-Fill Delete Confirmation, Auto Repair and Auto Sell Junk in the Retail layout
Display, Colors and Extras sections with inline swatches and auto accept and turn-in cogs
Wrath spell icons, real cast times and the same faction and portrait art as the live frames
The Active Profile dropdown shows the rename, delete and keybind icons on each profile again.
Dropdowns open again with !!!ClassicAPI installed; its clipping function no longer moves the menus into an empty scroll frame.
Resetting Global Settings no longer stops partway with an error and reloads the UI again.

Options that do nothing on the Wrath client are hidden: image sharpening, Lag Tolerance, Combat Text Size, Swiftmend dim, Slug outline, class resource dark mode and colors, Retail-only class and power colors, and cursor ring textures.
Global Settings no longer shows the Gamepad page, which has nothing to control on the Wrath client.
Max Camera Distance saves and keeps its value instead of resetting to 1.0, and goes up to 4 like the Wrath client allows.
CDM Bars and Tracking Bars open without an \"attempt to call field 'disabled'\" error, and nine toggles show their tooltips again.
Chat > Spam Filter: the chat type settings stay usable when only the trade or recruitment filter is on, and the tooltips explain what each one covers.
Opening the options no longer makes later Blizzard actions risk being blocked in EllesmereUI's name.

Checklist menus such as Visibility tick and untick their boxes as soon as they are clicked, even when the module's live update runs into a problem, instead of only after closing and reopening the menu.
Dropdown lists, checklists and other option popups draw their items above their own background, on a solid background, instead of showing faded items with the page bleeding through.
The Style page now keeps the Unit Frames health colors per look, so switching between Classic WoW UI and the EllesmereUI look keeps each one's colors.
The Unit Frames preview and power color swatches show the original game power colors under Classic WoW UI.
Each Core Text Position row, Spell Name, Cast Timer and Friendly Names now has its own gear for the outline instead of hiding it in the size popup.
Pressing Esc to close Blizzard windows no longer shows \"EllesmereUIOptions has been blocked from an action\".
Combat damage, healing, periodic and pet damage toggles use Wrath's own combat text settings.
Hidden option widgets no longer take keyboard focus after other windows close with Escape.
Dragging or typing in a slider no longer errors.
The settings panel opens on clients whose atlas lookup errors on unknown names, instead of failing with an 'NS' error.
Displays has a ZONE TEXT section with Move Zone Text.
Raid Tools no longer has a BOSS MOD BARS section: AbilityTimeline's Sources options hide DBM and BigWigs bars.

The Retail raid panel: show it never, in raids, in any group or always, as a resizable Compact Band, one or two windows, or only one part. It can start as a small icon, opens and closes with a keybind even in combat, and has three pull timers, Convert and Disband. Reinvite removes everyone and invites them back to the same kind of group, and Convert to Party rebuilds a raid of five or fewer as a party the same way. Shift + Left Click a marker to place its world marker when the marker item is in your bags, or Shift + Left Click the clear icon to reset world markers. In a raid it only shows for the leader and assistants.

One key casts Misdirection or Tricks of the Trade on your focus, the tank (typed name, Main Tank or tank role), your friendly target or your pet. An icon shows who it will go to, the buff timer and the cooldown. Bind it in Key Bindings.

Damage taken, healing, avoids and entering or leaving combat scroll above the player frame instead of Blizzard's combat text, with Straight, Fountain or Static animations, colors per type and a mover in Unlock Mode.
Picks an NPC's only dialog option for you. Hold Shift to skip it; instances and NPCs with quests to take or turn in are left alone. Its cog can also skip past low level quests.
An arrow next to the To box lists your alts on this realm and faction, guild members and the last names you mailed. Click a name to fill it in.
Pick None, Outline, Thick Outline or Shadow for the zone, sub-zone and PvP text shown when entering an area. Blizzard Default keeps the game's own font.
Posts the spell you or your pet interrupted, with a spell link, to Say, Emote, Party or Raid. Party and Raid switch to the battleground channel inside battlegrounds.
Group invites from your friends list and guildmates are accepted automatically, unless you are already grouped or queued in the Dungeon Finder.
A Disband button on Raid Tools removes everyone from your raid or party after a confirmation. Leader only, never in combat.
Loots everything instantly even with Blizzard's Auto Loot off; hold Shift to see the loot window. Locked slots such as group rolls and master loot are skipped.
FPS and latency, secondary stats, durability warning, combat and death alerts, a crosshair and a new target distance text, all movable in Unlock Mode.
The FPS counter's new default Text Color, Quality, turns FPS and each latency value green, yellow or red (60/30 fps, 100/250 ms). Custom and Class Color remain available.
Alert sounds from SharedMedia packs that load after Quality of Life play too
An Open All button takes items and gold one letter at a time, skipping COD and GM mail
With Send Mail open, Shift-click a bag item to attach it and matching items
Opens lootable containers one at a time out of combat (off by default)
A Train All button beside Train shows how many spells are available and the total cost
Pull timer length, DBM/BigWigs broadcast and a chat countdown
Raid Tools keeps its size after importing a Retail profile.
Shift-click mail attach no longer replaces the bag item click handler, so bag clicks stay free of taint.
Hiding DBM and BigWigs bars while AbilityTimeline is active moved to AbilityTimeline itself, as on Retail: Hide DBM bars and Hide BigWigs bars on its Sources page. The Raid Tools option is gone.
Logging out, exiting, releasing spirit and other Blizzard confirmation popups no longer trigger the \"EllesmereUIQoL has been blocked from an action only available to the Blizzard UI\" message.
The zone name no longer appears in the middle of the screen at small UI scales. It now sits fixed at the top (X 9 / Y 322 from screen center), with no Unlock Mode mover.
Show Player Buffs puts the hovered player's buffs as icons beside the tooltip, with position, size, icons per row and offsets.
Hovering a stat in the character sheet sidebar glows the equipped items that give it.

Inspect enchants show as an icon with the name on hover, or as names tinted by item quality, in their own size. At max level, red badges flag missing enchants, empty sockets and a missing belt buckle, as on your character sheet.
Saving an equipment set rebuilds the native icon picker even when already open, preventing the PaperDollFrame nil comparison error.
Need, Greed, Disenchant and Pass buttons on loot rolls count what the rest of the group picked. Hover a button to see who, in class colors.
Player tooltips show GearScore in the GearScoreLite colors, using its formula when it is loaded. GearScoreLite's own line is kept when its option is on.
Enchants and gems on every slot, lowest durability, model rotate, pan and zoom, reorderable stat sections and a socket strip that fills sockets from your bags.
Class colored names and health bar, guild rank, target, item level and a cursor or fixed anchor
Item levels on inspect, docking beside the character window and a merchant list mode
Resurrect accept glow and a Dungeon Ready countdown bar
The server's Collections and Wardrobe & Transmog windows join the window skins

Barber Shop, PvP and battlemasters, Arena Registrar, battleground score, minimap and capture bar, Help and GM tickets, GM chat status, breath and fatigue timers, stopwatch, raid pullouts, debug tools and Ace3 config windows
Ready checks no longer leave an empty black panel for the leader or after you answer.
The character sheet Titles tab lists your known titles again; click one to wear it.
The Guild Message Of The Day popup (and other wide text popups) no longer covers its title and buttons with the input box.
The Achievements window no longer darkens the achievement list behind its border.
The AddOn List window skin toggle only shows when the client has an AddOn List window.
Send Mail shows the To, Subject and message boxes again, and the typing cursor stays visible in skinned edit boxes.
The fixed tooltip anchor no longer snaps back to its saved spot while you drag it in Unlock Mode.
Auction House: panels and tabs added by Auctionator and other auction addons keep their own look and layout, and the footer Close buttons no longer get an \"x\" over their text.
Talents: the close button and the points footer end at the scroll bar instead of past the window edge.
Window tabs keep their dark background instead of showing through.
World map: the player arrow, party and raid dots, corpse and quest markers stay on the map art after a map view change during combat, including instance maps.
Native dropdown menus no longer show an empty square at the right of each row.
Dropdown boxes in Blizzard windows, such as the Dungeon Finder type, end at their arrow instead of past the window edge.
Raid Information: the background covers the whole window, including the title, close button, last row and the Extend Raid Lock and Close buttons.
The Talents and Glyphs background now ends above the tabs and beside the dual spec tabs.
The Glyphs tab shows its native parchment background again, aligned with the glyph sockets.
Sliders in Blizzard windows, such as the Camera and Mouse options, are back to their normal size.

New Cooldown States: Hide Until Usable shows a spell only while it can be cast and is off cooldown (Overpower, Revenge, Victory Rush, Execute); low resources do not hide it. Hide Outside Form/Stance shows it only in the form or stance it needs. Both can close the gap or keep the place.
The + menu adds an Empty Slot that keeps a position free on the bar, to group icons.
Bars can switch to a Shaped swipe that follows round icons and takes a Swipe Color, instead of the client's dark square sweep.
Cooldowns, Utility and Buffs bars plus custom bars and a FocusKick bar, tracked from your spellbook, cooldowns and auras. Lists are saved per talent group.
Aura or cooldown bars for player, target, focus or pet with textures, gradients, stack ticks and pandemic glow, arranged in groups.
The + buttons above the bar icons open Retail's add menu: custom spell, item or slot, trinkets, racial, potions and your learned spells, or buffs and buff presets from the gold +
Passive proc trinkets in the trinket slots show their icon and the internal cooldown after each proc, with the proc buff while it lasts
Tracking bar textures include SharedMedia, and the FocusKick Cast Sound adds EllesmereUI and SharedMedia sounds to the Blizzard ones
Light up EllesmereUI, Blizzard or ElvUI action buttons while an aura is active or missing
Always show, dim, hide on cooldown or when ready, and glow when ready
Racials, healthstones, Wrath potions and buffs such as Heroism and Bloodlust
Show an entry only when a chosen talent is learned

Racials show once: the Utility bar no longer lists Arcane Torrent (and other racials with class variants) three times.
A passive trinket in a trinket slot shows its own icon in the options instead of a question mark.
Bars saved twice or under another bar's name (two Buffs bars and no Cooldowns) are repaired, so each built-in bar keeps its own icons and options.
Auto Sized and Even Split bars with Retail backgrounds, borders and screen edge snapping, plus per-block margins, alignment, scale and colors.
Clock, FPS, latency, location, gold history, bags, durability, XP and reputation, dual spec, professions, travel, micro menu, currency and more.
Latency text is green, yellow or red by connection quality by default. A Latency swatch in Text Color switches back to it after picking another color.
Column tooltips with clickable rows and secure spell, item and macro lines
Every bar has a mover whose Element Options opens that bar's settings
Bars snapped to a screen edge or set to full length start in their place after login instead of needing Unlock Mode opened and closed.
The cast bar latency zone works for queued spells and remains visible during channels, with configurable color and millisecond text.
Class, Power and Health Bars, Cast Bar, GCD Bar, Swing Timer and Totem Bar, each element with its own Unlock Mode mover. Older profiles migrate once.
Main hand, off hand and ranged swings from the combat log, with queued Heroic Strike, Cleave and Maul, parry haste and speed changes.
Bar textures include textures from SharedMedia and other addons
Vertical bars, Retail texts, gradients, thresholds, tick marks and smoothing
Death Knight rune order and countdowns, combo points, or Blizzard's own art
Channel ticks, latency, total duration and uninterruptible colors
Totem icons and timers, and a movable Call Totem Bar
The Call Totem Bar no longer resizes or moves during combat; changes apply when combat ends.
The player cast bar shows the channeled spell's name instead of \"Channeling\".
Class icons in the EUI themes, status orbs, notes in the details line, faction banners and hover highlight, with borders and accent colors.
Accepts group invites from friends, and optionally from guild members, and closes the popup.
The window stays native but rows still get class icons and colored names
Auto Accept picks quests from NPC dialogs, with Prevent Multi Quest Accept, and Auto Turn In completes single-reward quests. Hold Shift to skip.
Uses the item of your tracked quest, found in the quest log, and only holds the key while there is an item to use.
The top line uses the accent color and Line Color tints the header divider
Clear your focus by clicking the focus frame (Shift + Right Click by default, or Ctrl/Alt + Right Click, Middle Click, Shift + Left Click). Set it on the Focus frame page. Works in combat.

Two new debuff filter modes: Raid Debuffs shows the common raid debuffs from anyone (armor, spell and physical damage taken, crit taken, attack power, attack and cast speed, healing taken, Judgements and Hunter's Mark), and Own and Raid Debuffs adds yours.

Type Icon Position puts the icon of the player's highest dispellable debuff type on a point of the health bar, with its size and offsets in the cog. Only Dispellable by You now sits beside it and narrows the overlay, icon and border colors alike.
The focus frame gets the aura Border Style, size and color settings, as player and target have.
Player, target and focus show incoming heals past the health fill: yours and other players' in their own colors, from LibHealComm-4.0 (only healers running a HealComm addon are seen).
The debuff filters can now show or hide Sated, Exhaustion and the other Bloodlust lockout debuffs. They stay hidden by default.
Left, Right, Center and Extra Text, the Bottom Text Bar texts and Power Percent each have an Outline choice under Size: None, Outline, Thick Outline or Shadow, or the module default.
Anchor, growth, icons per row, duration and stack text, textured borders and dispel rings. Target and focus get Purgeable Buff Glow.
Every combat indicator style now shows, and highlighted portraits fit their shape instead of overflowing it.
Player, target, focus and boss health bars show estimated damage shields with Retail's Absorb Style, Opacity, Color, Placement, Show Overshield and Show on Boss Frames
Mana or Mana + Form Power, with a separate form bar
Threat %, a pet power bar and the pet happiness icon
Pooled aura indicators on the health bar with Use Indicator Layout
Fill, full, gradient and sharp gradient overlays in the dispel color
Under Classic WoW UI and Blizzard Style, the leader crown sits on the portrait's top corner, as on the original frames, instead of inside the health bar.
The party leader icon on unit frames shows on the leader only instead of on several party members.
Set Focus and Clear Focus in the unit frame right-click menu work out of combat without the 'blocked from an action' popup; in combat they are hidden.
Unit frame bars and portraits no longer get moved into scroll frames when !!!ClassicAPI is installed.
Important Cast Glow is hidden for target and focus cast bars; the Wrath client cannot tell which spells are important.
Channel cast bars show the spell's name instead of \"Channeling\".
Boss frames now update health, power and text while the boss is not your target or focus.
Visibility conditions (combat, group, and hiding without a target) now apply to the frames instead of stopping with an error, so the Visibility menu's boxes also tick right away.
Classic WoW UI power bars now stay inside the frame art: the art's rim draws over the power bar as it does over the health bar.
Classic WoW UI now gives every unit frame the original green health bar instead of class colors. Returning to the EllesmereUI look restores your colors.
Classic WoW UI power bars use the original game colors (deep blue mana, red rage, yellow energy) instead of the EllesmereUI palette. Other looks keep the palette.
Text outlines now apply to the live frames, not only the options preview.
Unit frames no longer fail to load on setups whose mask textures come back empty (absorb bar error at login).
Icons shown by spell ID now show the right icon or a question mark, never an empty square.
The faction indicator no longer errors in mercenary mode, and Retail-only PvP styles use the Wrath PvP icon.
Level text no longer errors with Font not set when frames are first created.

Like Retail 9.4, the Experience Bar section opens with XP Bar Style: EllesmereUI for the EUI bar, Luxthos for the EUI bar in the Luxthos WeakAura layout, or Blizz Default for Blizzard's own XP and reputation bars. It replaces Enable Experience Bar and the Apply Luxthos Layout button.

Like Retail 9.4, any horizontal bar can show the classic gryphons at its left end, right end or both, from the End Caps menu at the end of LAYOUT. The cog sets their size and offsets, and Apply to All copies them to every bar. The live preview shows them too.

The XP bar gets Retail's Quest XP Overlay (completed quests in green, incomplete in gold), dividers with Smart Ticks, gradient fills, background and rested colors, and seven text positions showing values, completed quest XP, XP per hour, time to level and time played. Apply Luxthos Layout recreates the popular Luxthos XP bar WeakAura, with Show at Max Level, a spark and rested XP after quest XP.
Buttons holding an equipped item, such as a trinket, can show a border in its rarity color. Off by default.
Four extra bars, off by default, each with its own keybinds, Unlock Mode mover and the full Bar Display settings. Warriors, Druids, Rogues and Priests see which stance or form shares a bar's slots.
Circle and Portrait draw round icons, Diamond, Hexagon and Shield crop the icon to the shape, and Square and Curved Square add a shaped outline. Set per bar, including pet and stance.
Type /kb, hover a button and press a key to bind it, including modifiers, mouse buttons and the wheel. Right-click clears; Cancel or Esc undoes.
Per-bar text, borders, backgrounds, orientation and growth, the Retail button animations and visibility engine, and Bar 1 modifier paging.
Shift+1 shows as S1, Control+1 as C1, mouse buttons as M4 and the wheel as MwU/MwD
Shrink the bag bar to a single backpack button
Square micro menu and bag bar, flat XP and reputation bars and movable buffs and debuffs
Bar 1 paging arrows change the page without the \"blocked from an action only available to the Blizzard UI\" message.
Changing stance no longer reveals a duplicate Blizzard stance and pet bar.
Spells can be dropped on Bar 1 while the Blizzard bar art is hidden.
Player Buffs keep growing downward as rows are added.
The XP and reputation bars no longer error on their first update.
Create Soulstone reminders, including custom spell reminders, only appear for Warlocks.
A Holy-only reminder for your Seal of Wisdom, including when another seal is active.
One click casts your group buff, such as Fortitude, Gift of the Wild or Arcane Brilliance, at its highest rank on the first member missing it.
Auras, presences, aspects, shields, weapon imbues, poisons, pets, Soulstone and Healthstone, plus flask, elixir and food with bag counts.
Reminder sounds include SharedMedia sounds, even from packs that load later
World, normal and heroic dungeons and raids, or in combat, with Show Below timers
Talent reminders for Wrath zones and your current instance
Your own aura ID reminders and a healer mana Ready Check Warning
Middle-click hides a reminder until the next loading screen
Turning off Runeforging now hides the Death Knight rune reminder.
Adding zones to an older talent reminder no longer errors, and the new zones apply right away.

Bag keybinds open and close the existing layout during combat. Layout refreshes wait until combat ends.
A sidebar with All Items, OneBag and MultiBag views, pinned and recent items, Retail categories for Wrath items and your own categories.
OneBag merges stacks and sorts by bag type, MultiBag sorts each bag, with Sort to Bottom and Randomize.
A cog beside the search opens the Bags options, or the Bank page at the bank
Each saved character in the Characters list has an x to delete its data
Quality borders, quest marks, item level, BoE text, set names and dimmed junk
Group the bank by category, with a sidebar
With Enable Bags off, the default bag functions are no longer replaced, avoiding blocked action errors from tainted bag code.
Opening the Characters list no longer errors.
Gold sale ads with websites or cash prices, including 5000G=20 bucks and disguised W.W.W addresses, are filtered by default in your selected chat scopes.
Unsupported server channel notices such as NOT_IN_LFG no longer cause the native chat formatter to error.
Optional spam filtering with a repeat window, sender matching and public, group or whisper controls.
Background, divider, input position, Retail border and tabs over the native dock, plus a sidebar with friends, guild, copy, channels and settings.
Retail timestamps, short channel names, class colored names, link tooltips, whisper sounds, saved chat history and Retail URL and copy windows.
Show Hidden Messages lists the last 200 lines the spam filter hid this session, with time, reason, channel and sender. Clear Filter History is now Reset Repeat Memory.
The trade ad preset also hides LFW (looking for work) crafting ads.
Right-click the chat in Unlock Mode to open its Display settings
